title: Breakout
description: Classic brick breaker game. Bounce the ball off the paddle and destroy all the bricks!

title: Pong
description: Classic arcade game with three difficulty levels. Battle the AI in fast-paced paddle action!

title: Avoider
description: Fast-paced dodging game. Control your player and avoid falling obstacles for as long as you can!

title: Classic Snake
description: Classic snake game. Eat food, grow longer, don't hit walls or yourself!
Slide numbered tiles to combine them and reach 2048. Addictive puzzle game!

title: Chess
description: Classic chess game. Play against a friend with full move validation and checkmate detection.

title: Checkers
description: Classic checkers game. Jump your opponent's pieces and crown your kings to victory!

title: Minesweeper
description: Classic minesweeper game. Flag the mines and reveal all safe cells to win!

title: Solitaire
description: Classic solitaire card game. Build foundations from Ace to King in each suit!

title: Invaders
description: Classic space invaders arcade game. Destroy alien waves before they reach Earth!

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Classic tic-tac-toe game. Get three in a row before your opponent does!

title: Memory Match
description: Classic memory card game. Flip cards to find matching pairs and test your memory!

title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Classic hand game. Choose rock, paper, or scissors and beat the computer!

title: Sliding Puzzle
description: Classic 15-puzzle game. Slide tiles to arrange numbers 1-15 in order!

title: Sudoku
description: Classic number puzzle. Fill the 9x9 grid so each row, column, and 3x3 box contains 1-9!

title: Flappy Bird
description: Side-scrolling game. Tap or press space to flap through the pipes without crashing!

title: Reaction Timer
description: Test your reflexes! Click as fast as you can when the screen turns green.

title: Typing Speed Test
description: Test your typing speed and accuracy. Type the displayed text as fast as you can!
